articleTitle: Matters within your control (Electricity at Work Regulations 1989)
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Management Responsibilities in the Electricity at Work Regulations
abstract: On the 1st April 1990 a new set of regulations, designed to protect work-people against dangers from electricity, came into force. These regulations, called the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 replace or modify a number of statutory provisions to the effect that electrical safety is governed by these Regulations alone within the United Kingdom. Moreover these Regulations cover all people at work and not just those in factories, etc., as before. The number of people covered has been trebled. The author considers the regulations that do not apply to mines and also presents tables of work descriptions.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989: management's responsibilities-the law
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Management Responsibilities in the Electricity at Work Regulations
abstract: The relationship between the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 and the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974 is discussed, together with the status of Approved Codes of Practice and HSE Guidance material. The levels of duty, and types of dutyholder under the Act and the Regulations are defined.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
